children: Truist Securities maintained their Buy rating on Okta's stock with a price target of $235.00.
The price target implies an upside of 13.7% from the Sep 24 close of $206.64.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Okta's all-in-one identity platform is gaining traction among customers, particularly in high-value accounts, while its focus on governance and Privileged Access Management (PAM) is expected to drive further growth and customer acquisition.

: By collaborating with industry leaders through initiatives like the Blueprint Alliance, Okta is enhancing its capabilities in AI agent governance and positioning itself as a neutral foundational layer in the technology stack, which could accelerate enterprise adoption of its solutions.
Across the five most recent analyst notes published on OKTA over the past 30 days, price targets range from $160 to $240.
